about: Picks on a closed Fort Week, stated once. tests/kingdom.test.js runs these against checkPicks's newNames, and supabase/tests/test_pick_governor.py runs them against pick_governor. Governors are { id, name } with name as the current name; nameHistory is { id, name }. rows are the week's read rows in ranking order, { name, fortCount, id, names? }, id null for "needs ID" and names every spelling the reader saw for a row read more than one way. picks are the Council's Picks, [{ row, id }] with row an index into rows. newNames is what the Picks add to Name History, [{ id, name }], each first seen the week's Monday. A name another row of the week carries, or was also read as, stays out. Names and IDs are made up so they never meet real Governors.

cases.case: a Pick adds the row's name under the picked Governor
a name another row of the week also carries stays out
a name another row was also read as stays out
a name the Governor already has in Name History is not added again
